title: Bind assertions to the artifact schema that declares the field
failure_signature: The first isolated evidence module loaded the CBR mutation receipt when asserting contract-level absent-or-reserved authority fields, causing one KeyError after 17 passing checks.
trigger_preconditions: A proposal emits separate contract and mutation evidence artifacts.
candidate_workaround: Load cbr/live-performance-remedy-matrix.json for contract-level authority reservations and keep the mutation receipt for mutation counts only.
recurrence_guard: Bind each test assertion to the artifact schema that declares the asserted field.
rollback: Retain the failed module run, award it no aggregate credit, and leave the correct CBR artifacts unchanged.
scope_boundary: Bounded test-surface correction only; no authority, completion, or independent-reproduction credit.
